title: Subsume Hermes Agent: executive front door, optional worker, ported curator
observation: Operator asked to subsume Hermes Agent functionality and optimizations and split it between Orchestrator OS and Agent OS executive function. Hermes already ships the messaging gateway, scheduled jobs, voice, bounded memory and self-maintained skills that EXEC-7/11.5/12/13 and P2.2 still need.
suspected_root_cause: Executive features are unbuilt; building gateways, schedulers and voice in-house would duplicate a maintained MIT project.
suggested_direction: Run Hermes behind stable seams (CLI one-shot worker, MCP, memory-provider plugin) with Agent OS canonical; port the curator lifecycle and fallback wait threshold; phases H1-H6 in the evaluation, each with its own test.
acceptance: H1: a `hermes_cli` orchestrator adapter passes synthetic adapter tests and one live benchmark A/B against Codex on a local model
H2: an Agent OS memory-provider plugin turns Hermes memory writes into candidates only and keeps prefetch inside the context budget
H3: a no-agent cron Daily Brief generated by an Agent OS script is delivered on one platform with approval-gated sending and at-least-once delivery
H4: the skill curator lifecycle runs deterministically on the Agent OS skill registry with pinned/referenced exemptions and a dry-run
H5: self-evolution improves one skill with noninferior protected-holdout results, output as a reviewable candidate
H6: the router waits for a provider whose reset is within a threshold instead of failing over to a costlier one
risks: Upstream churn without internal compatibility shims
Forked memory state if built-in Hermes memory is used alongside Agent OS
Inbound message exposure through the gateway
Paid spend through Nous Portal/OpenRouter if enabled

source.reference: 2026-10-01 request to evaluate and subsume Hermes Agent and split it between Orchestrator OS and executive function

notes: Evaluation only; no runtime adoption yet. Agent OS stays canonical for durable state.
